To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the N-acyl-hydrazone derivatives 4a–c are anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and less gastrotoxic compared to the respective parent nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug.
the synthesized compounds 4a and 4c were found to be the best anti-inflammatory and analgetic agents, respectively, among the synthesized series.
the compounds 4a, 4b, 4d and 4e are anti-inflammatory compounds with reduced ulcerogenicity and increased analgesic activity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis and pharmacological evaluation of a series of anti-inflammatory compounds containing the N-acyl-hydrazone subunit.
the synthesis of a new series of N-acylated hydrazones and their evaluation of pharmacological properties.
the development of new anti-inflammatory drugs with reduced gastrotoxity and analgesic activity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the N-acylhydrazone derivatives of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug possess good anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antiulcer activities.
compounds 4b–c have a higher anti-inflammatory and analgetic potential than their parent drug.
the N-acyl-hydrazone derivatives of NSAIDs are a new and promising class of anti-inflammatory agents with a reduced ulcerogenic potential.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the hydrazone substructure has been successfully incorporated into non-steroidal drugs to produce derivatives with improved anti-inflammatory and analgetic properties.
the N-acyl-hydrazone derivatives are a new class of anti-inflammatory compounds with reduced gastro-toxicity.
the N-acylhydrazone subunit is a promising scaffold for the design of new anti-inflammatory and analge-sic drugs with low ulcerogenic potential.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the introduction of an N-acylamino group in non-steroidal drugs can be used as an alternative to the sulfonamide moiety to improve their pharmacological profile.
the N-acyl-hydrazone subunit is an interesting pharmacophoric subunit that may be useful in the design of new anti-inflammatory and analagesic drugs.
N-acyl-hydrazone derivatives can be used as a template to obtain anti-inflammatory compounds with reduced ulcerogenic effects.
